newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed, gas oil up $1, mogas flat.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, gas oil up $1, mogas flat.

text.p: NWE oil products open mixed on Tuesday morning with gas oil firmer but gasoline and fuel flat.
Gas oil rose $1 a tonne on futures but premiums for barges and cargoes were unchanged. Traders pegged barges at 25 cents a tonne under $161.25 on July IPE which traded at 0953 GMT.
Gasoline sellers asked $185 fob ARA for barges and $186 for July refinery product. Swaps talked $181.50 for July and August.
Heavy fuel was flat. High sulphur Rotterdam barges traded at $82 and $82.50 early while swaps talked $82.50 for July and August.
